model_family_note: Same family as the model authoring this project (Claude Sonnet 5), for consistency with the intended advanced-system model per BUGPROOF_AGENT_BRIEF.md's model-consistency requirement. No Anthropic API key was available in this environment for a raw SDK call; using OpenAI/Google keys present but unrelated to this benchmark was declined to avoid breaking model-family consistency and spending unauthorized credits. See src/bugproof/baseline.py module docstring and PRIOR_WORK.md.
temperature: not configurable at this layer (Claude Code subagent default)
max_output_tokens: not configurable at this layer (Claude Code subagent default)
reasoning_effort: not configurable at this layer (Claude Code subagent default)
tools_available_to_subagent: all (general-purpose subagent default: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, ...)
self_check_execution_allowed: at most one pytest run of its own candidate against buggy/, per the fixed task prompt
token_usage_source: Agent tool per-subagent usage report (subagent_tokens, tool_uses, duration_ms)
token_usage_note: subagent_tokens is a single total, not split into input/output; this is what the tool exposes and nothing was estimated beyond it
cost_unavailable_reason: Claude Code's Agent tool does not expose per-subagent dollar cost to the orchestrating session; not estimated or fabricated
cassette_note: Offline replay in this environment means replaying the recorded subagent trajectory and frozen candidate, not re-issuing a raw HTTP request from a cassette file. eval/run_baseline_replay.py re-runs the deterministic oracle against the frozen candidates with no LLM call and no API key, which is the part R5 requires a judge be able to reproduce offline.
transcript_evidence_limitation: Only 1 of 12 cases (discount_unit_mismatch) has a recoverable raw subagent JSONL transcript; the other 11 were found to be 0 bytes at the source (Claude Code task-output retention/eviction, not something broken by this session's copy step) and are marked *_transcript.MISSING.md in evidence/baseline/trajectories/ rather than fabricated. This is an evidence limitation of the original baseline run, disclosed here rather than implied away. A structured per-case trajectory.md (agent-authored) and the frozen candidate_test.py remain available for all 12 cases.
